title: Tag
summary: The dismiss (x) button now has a 24px hit area around the unchanged 12px icon, a neutral 18px hover plate, and its own focus ring instead of the browser default. The tag itself does not grow: a -6px margin keeps the old 12px footprint (tag stays 24px high and, for the sample, 88.875px wide).
apiNote: No prop, aria-label (default "Remove", or removeAriaLabel), type or onClick change. Both visuals are pseudo-elements, so the DOM is unchanged and the v1 markup parity test still passes.
why: WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.5.8 asks for 24 x 24 CSS px targets; a bare 12px icon is hard to hit, especially inside dense chip lists. The brief's research points the same way for comparable chip/pill components.
A soft neutral plate on hover/focus shows the real target without recolouring the tag; black at 8% works on every status surface (grey, teal, blue, green, amber, red) where a fixed grey would not.
The remove button had no styled focus state: keyboard users saw the browser's default blue ring (see the BEFORE capture).
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.

scenarioLabels.removable-hover: Removable tag, hover on the x
scenarioLabels.removable-focus: Removable tag, keyboard focus on the x
scenarioLabels.removable-disabled: Dismiss disabled, hover (no plate, no scale)

motion.after: Opacity 0 -> 8% in 150ms ease-out; on hover-capable pointers and on keyboard focus; never on a disabled button

motion.before: Hover 1.03 (also on touch), press 0.96, 80ms down / 200ms spring return
motion.after: Unchanged values; hover scale only on hover-capable pointers; none under reduced motion

states: Tag / Remove button: Rest, Hover, Focus (keyboard), Pressed, Disabled, for all 9 variants x 3 sizes
Tag / Remove button / Hover and Focus: neutral plate 18 x 18
Tag / Remove button / Focus: ring replaces the browser default
figmaSteps: Remove button layer: keep the X icon at 12 x 12 (unchanged), colour inherited from the tag text. Wrap it in a 24 x 24 transparent frame (the hit area), corner radius 9999, icon centred.

Layout footprint stays 12 x 12 so the tag does not grow: place the 24 x 24 frame with "Ignore auto layout" at X -6, Y -6 relative to the icon, or keep the 12 x 12 slot and overlay the larger frame (code uses margin -6 on every side). Tag heights stay 20 / 24 / 30 and paddings stay sm 6, default 8, lg 12; gap between label, value and button stays 6.

Hover plate (new layer "Hover plate" behind the icon, inside the 24 x 24 frame): ellipse 18 x 18 centred (3px inset on each side), fill #000000 (--color-black) at 8% opacity, no stroke. Visible in the Hover and Focus states, hidden at rest and when disabled. Fade 150ms ease-out.

Focus state: plate visible (8%) plus a ring ellipse 18 x 18 with an OUTSIDE stroke 1px #343E55 (semantic-primary) and offset 1 (22 x 22 outer circle); this replaces the browser default ring. On the 20px small tag the 18px plate fits with a 1px margin top and bottom.
Pressed: scale 0.96 (80ms), released with a 200ms spring; hover scale is 1.03. Unchanged from before.
Disabled: whole button at 50% opacity, no plate, no scale (unchanged apart from the plate).
notes: The hit area extends 6px beyond the icon on each side and 2px above/below the 20px small tag; it is invisible and does not change layout, but it overlaps the 6px gap to the label up to the label's edge.
The focus ring is an ::after pseudo-element: opacity on the plate (::before) would otherwise fade the ring to 8% as well (found and fixed during capture).
Replaying the v1 tag tests on v2 fails 14 tests, all v1 utility-class assertions.

The measured tables cannot read pseudo-elements: the hover plate (::before) and focus ring (::after) are in the `evals` of removable*.after.json. Plate: absolute 18 x 18, radius 9999px, background #000000, opacity 0 at rest / 0.08 on hover and focus, transition opacity 150ms. Hit area measured 24 x 24 (24.72 while hover-scaled 1.03).

In the keyboard-focus table, the Remove button outline change (browser auto ring #005FCC -> a transparent 2px outline) is the browser default being removed; the visible ring is the ::after (1px #343E55, offset 1px, 22 x 22 outer).
The Tag element itself has no rows in any table: its width (88.875px in the sample), height (24px), padding (8px) and gap (6px) are identical before and after, which is the point of the -6px margin.
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.
